capability.summary: List public holidays for a country and year
capability.description: Fetches Nager.Date PublicHolidays/<year>/<country_code> using required CLI positions year then country_code. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Country/year public-holiday reference; not personal calendar scheduling, business closure guarantees, or legal advice.

constraint.io_signature: Input: year at CLI position 1 and country_code at position 2. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and Nager result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: ISO-like country code accepted by Nager.Date
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: no subdivision, language, holiday-type, pagination, or date-range input
wrapper does not locally truncate or normalize the holiday array
coverage and observed-holiday rules depend on Nager.Date data; no auth, cache, or retry

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing country/year public-holiday records, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: find public holidays by country and year
negative_intents: guarantee an employer or venue closure
